reasons: field 'expression_count' type changed: dict[str, int] -> dict[str, int] | None

correctness_argument: Guzman 2018 (#964) deposits its RNA-seq as one processed file, GEO GSE117303's deseq2-tpm.csv.gz: TPM for 14 libraries and no read counts, although the Methods describe counting with summarizeOverlaps. RNASeqExpressionPhenotype required expression_count, so the study's own release could not be stored at all (owner rule 2026-10-12: every released value is stored; an unstated value is a typed gap). expression_count stays required and becomes value-or-gap: None ONLY beside a ProvenanceGap on 'expression_count' naming the file it was looked for in; the matching-keys rule still applies whenever counts are present. No record the old contract accepted changes meaning: every stored record carries counts and validates unchanged. The record-merging path (mean_experiment_deduplicate) makes a merge that includes a gapped record a gap rather than summing a partial set, and the RNA-seq verifier skips gapped counts. Breaking for the served RNA-seq closures by fingerprint only; lands with the KG 4.0 full rebuild.

source_quotes.quote: The RNAseq data is available in the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database under the accession number GSE117303.

alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: Same physical measurement and the same released quantity (TPM) as RNASeqExpressionPhenotype; policy Rule 6 case 1 reuses the leaf, and a missing companion value is a typed gap (Rule 3).
Counts cannot be recovered from TPM without the unreleased library sizes and gene lengths; it would invent values.
